title: Measurement Execution (MX-*, MPA v1)
description: A stable ADDRESSING SCHEME over one line of configs/research/measurement_result_log.jsonl — NOT a second store. `MX-<run_id>` names the execution that a provenance record's EXECUTION slot points at. The result log stays the system of record; this schema documents the projection the resolver reads. FROZEN v1.0.0. Authoritative prose: docs/governance/MEASUREMENT_PROVENANCE_ARCHITECTURE.md.

mx_id.description: MX-<run_id>. An address, not a new identity — the run_id belongs to the result-log line.

contract_id.description: The sealed contract this run executed. The CONTRACT/EXECUTION split is the architecture's central correction: the 2026-08-26 audit had ONE measurement-basis slot, so naming a contract and running it were indistinguishable (its U4_DECLARED_NOT_EXECUTED rule fired 56 times).

trust_mt00.description: E-MT-00 clean-path verdict. Vocabulary mirrors measurement_result_log.MT00_VALUES exactly.

trust_mt01_matrix_coverage.description: E-MT-01 adversarial matrix coverage. 0/27 probes exist repo-wide, so every execution today is UNRUN here.

artifact_hashes.description: repo-relative path -> sha256 of the artifact as it stood at run time. Content proof WITHOUT requiring the artifact to be git-tracked, which matters because results/ is gitignored.

basis_status.description: Run-grain basis classification. NEVER `PRESERVED` — that is an identity CheckResult status, and a result line is not an L5 object.

economic_claims_allowed.description: PINNED false. The charter's E4 seal needs mt00 == PASS AND mt01_matrix_coverage == COMPLETE; coverage is 0/27, so no execution can open this gate. An execution proves a run HAPPENED, never that its result is economic.
